newsitem.title: USA: MBS specialty firm Howard B Hill hires senior vp.
newsitem.headline: MBS specialty firm Howard B Hill hires senior vp.

text.p: Mortgage boutique Howard B Hill & Co of Oyster Bay, N.Y., announced that it has hired Mark Dellecave as senior vice president and member.
Dellecave will serve as an advisor to clients and he will be involved with trading and sales, said Howard Hill, managing member of the eponymous business.

Previously, Dellecave was a managing director and principal at R.W. Pressprich & Co, Inc. At Pressprich & Co, Dellecave headed up the firm's mortgage sales and trading. Prior to working at Pressprich & Co, Dellecave was head of dealer sales at Prudential Securities Inc.
Howard B. Hill & Co was founded a year ago by Hill, a former managing director of the securitized products department at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
The firm is looking to establish a niche for itself as a broker and structurer of special securitized products as well as a provider of securitized product analytics.
